tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshe ril bsgrub pa dang tshe dbang bskur tshul 'chi med dpal ster bzhugs/

gang gi mtshan tsam bzung bas 'chi bdag gi /mche ba ri mo'i gnas la 'god byed cing*/ /tshe dang ye shes nges ster bde ldan du/ /'khrid mdzad bcom ldan tshe dpag med la 'dud/ /'dir tshe dpag med sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don byed par 'dod na/ tshe bsgrub dang*/ tshe dbang bskur ba'i tshul gnyis las dang po la/ bdag mdun gnyis las/ bdag bskyed ni/ skyabs sems tshad med rnams sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid hrīḥyig dmar po ring cha tshe drag dang bcas pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rgyal ba tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng na 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras shing*/ lha rdzas kyi dar gyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs mdzes par gsol ba/ 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang gi spyi bor oṃ dkar po nas hūṃ sngon po/ /de las 'od zer 'phros/ bde ba can nas rgyal ba tshe dpag med la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ nas chu lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las sprul sku tshe dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te 'bul ba ni/ tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas bsams/ bsdu na/ oṃ ār+ya a pā ra mi ta ā ur dz+nyā na sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod cing*/

'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ / ces sogs kyi bstod la/ rang gi thugs ka'i zla gdan gyi steng du hrīḥyig dmar po'i mthar bzlas bya'i sngags phreng gis bskor ba/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i tshe dpal bsod nams thams cad bkug nas sngags 'phreng la thim par gyur par bsams la/ gzungs ring thung gnyis ci 'grub bzlas nas mthar yig brgya brjod cing*/ sngar bzhin mchod bstod bya'o/ /gnyis pa mdun bskyed ni/ brag zhun cong zhi/ bu ram/ mar/ gar/ sbrang rtsi/ shugs 'bras sogs bcud len dang*/ gzhan dug rigs min pa'i sman sna tshogs dang*/ bum rdzas nyer lnga sogs las ril bu ci 'dod byas pa na bza' dmar po sogs gang rigs su bsgyur te skam pa bum pa bzang po'i nang du blugs nas stegs kyi khang bzhag la/ mchod pas mtha' bskor te 'chad 'gyur ltar byin brlab bya/ bum pa sngar bzhin bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa dmar po mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan zhing*/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis dkris pa'i nang du/ tshe ril rnams yongs su gyur pa las hrīḥyig dmar po re re/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ zhes pa nas rang nyid zhes pa dor te/ sngar bzhin dang*/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa re rer gyur/ de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ nas bdag la zhes pa ni 'di la zhes par bsgyur ba ma gtogs sngar ltar ro/ /de nas rab 'byams rgya mtsho'am/ mchod yon phal cher sogs dang*/ sngags tsam gyis mchod la/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i sogs dang*/ bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ /sdig pa'i dri ma phyir bsal nas/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sku mnga' ba/ /mnyam nyid sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes pa dang*/ rgyas pa na nyi gzhon 'char ka mas bstod kyang mi 'gal/ de nas de rnams kyi thugs ka dang phyag mtshan bum pa'i nang du zla gdan gyi steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/

rang dang bsgrub bya'i tshe mi ma yin gyis 'phrogs pa dang brkus pa dang yar pa la sogs pa rnams bum pa dang lhung bzed bdud rtsis bkang ba'i rnam par bsdus nas sngags phreng la thim/ yang 'od zer 'phros 'byung ba sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i ro bcud nus pa thams cad dang*/ skye 'phags thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs/ sngags dang sman la sogs pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bcud kyi snying po thams cad bsdus nas sngags phreng rnams la thim par gyur pas bsams la/ gzungs thung la gtso bor 'bad cing*/ gzungs ring ci mang bzla/ mthar ye shes gsum lan bdun sogs dang*/ yig brgya brjod cing*/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus dang ma rnyed sogs kyis bzod gsol byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po la tshe dang bsod nams ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ 'dir ni rten dang sogs kyis brtan bzhugs byas te/ shis brjod spyi dang*/ phyin drug dang sbyar ba'i bkra shis bya'o/ /gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ gong gi yig brgya'i mjug dar byin brlabs byas na a kā ro'am/ oṃ a pā ra mi tas 'bul rung*/ gzhi bdag gtor ma gtong 'dod na'ang spyi ltar 'bul/ 'di'i skabs su thun du bcad de bsgrubs na ni phun sum tshogs par 'gyur yang*/ ma byas kyang chad lhag tu mi 'gyur bar gang bde bya/ nyi ma gcig gam gsum mam bdun la sogs par byas te/ grol nyid par mchod bstod yig brgya dang bcas mjug tu bzod gsol dang gsol 'debs byas rjes/ lha rnams 'od du zhu nas ril bu'i rnam par gyur par bsams la/ brtan bzhugs dang shis brjod bya'o/ /de ltar bsgrub pa ni rgyas pa'i dbang du byas la/ bsdu na bum nang gi ril bu rnams kyi steng du zla gdan la gnas pa'i hrīḥrang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bcud rnams bsdus nas de nyid la thim par bsam zhing*/

sngags bzlas kyang chog par bshad/ de ltar bsgrubs pa'i ril bu zos pa'i phan yon ni 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa gzhan la dbang bskur ba la bdag mdun gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sngar ltar bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du btang nas/ gnyis pa mdun bskyed kyi tshe/ tshe bum dbus/ tshe chang g.yas/ tshe ril g.yon/ mchod pa dang gtor mas mtha' bskor la/ mchod pa oṃ pad+ma na ta kṛ ta hūṃ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog/bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams rang bzhin bde stong rnam par mchod rdzas byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag med kyi bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ pād+yāṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ a lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi te/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ gis byin gyis brlab/ de nas tshe bum pad+mān+ta kṛta hūṃ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bha bas sbyangs/ tshe bum mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las tshe bum phyi bum pa dmar po lto ba che ba/ mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan zhing -, nang lha'i gzhal yas khang grub bzhi/ rta babs bzhi ldan rdo rje'i ra ba me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ 'dir rma byas btegs pa'i rin po ུ chu ེ'i ུ khru ི'i steng du zhes bshad pa ltar ram/ yang na de'i |2༈ ༈ 0ཾ āḥ༈ 0ིཾ |ྃ ི āḥ༈ d 2ཿི 8ེ༈ 0 =༈/ oṃm̐ ༁ིྃ| ེྃ༈ 0 |ོoṃ ེྂ 3ཾོ| 2༄༅ོ| ྀི 2oṃ ེཾ/ 2d༈ 0ཿི 5ེ bo?2 3ཿི 5ེ :oṃ 2 |ྃ ཿ/ོoṃ 2 ¿3༈ ཿ༅༅ 0ཿི .3 ིgas pa bya zhing*/ gzungs ring thung gnyis ci 'grub dang mthar yig brgya brjod/ de nas gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung raṃ las me āḥlas mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/

de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ 'og gi rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu yi ge gsum las 'od 'phros rgya mtsho na gnas pa'i bdud rtsi dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug nas yi ge gsum la thim/ de rnams zhu nas thod pa'i nang gi bdud rtsir thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum brjod/ de ni bsdus pa'i lugs yin la/ rgyas par byed na'ang byas chog /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur par bsams/ a kā ro'am/ mtshan gyi mthar i daṃ ba liṃ ta btags pa gsum gyis 'bul/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs kyis bstod la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang slob ma rnams la tshe dang bsod nams la sogs pa'i dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba gdab/ tshe chang nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab/ tshe ril bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las tshe ril rnams sman sna tshogs las grub pa'i ril bur gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bcud thams cad bsdus nas tshe ril la thim par gyur par bsams la/ gnyis ka la dmigs pa'i yi ge gsum dang gzungs ring thung bzla/ brel ba'i tshe bdag bskyed skad cig gis bskyed kyang mi 'gal zhing*/ phyag len la bum pa zan las byed pa snang yang*/ bum pa ltar bskyed na ma gtogs bum nang du lha bskyed pa'i tshe bum pa dngos kyis kyang rung bar sems so/ /de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas nas maṇ+ḍal rgyas bsdus ci rigs 'bul du gzhug /kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam 'joms pa/ /de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter/ /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol/ /zhes pa lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi gnad dril ba'i dmigs skor spyi dang bye brag gi chos ji ltar rigs pa bshad/

spro na gdams pa 'di'i lo rgyus dang che ba brjod cing spro ba bskyed/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad bzhugs par mos te skyabs su 'gro ba dang sdig pa bshags pa sngon du 'gro bas byang sdoms 'dzin dgos pa'i brda sprad nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs bzhi lan gsum rjes zlos byed du gzhug la brjod/ de nas maṇ+ḍal bstan pa ni/ gnas khang 'di nyid kyang bde ba can lta bu dag pa'i zhing du mos pa dang*/ tshe bum 'di nyid kyang phyi bum pa la nang lha'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i dbus su rgyal ba tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhes sogs mngon rtogs dang mthun par rgyas bsdus ci rigs kyis brda sprad/ de nas slob ma rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hrīḥlas slob ma rnams sam re re nas rgyal ba tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhes sogs sngar bzhin bskyed cing*/ bla ma yang de lta bu'i tshe dpag med dngos yin snyam pa'i 'du zhes bskyed du bcug nas mang nyung dang bstun te/ slob ma'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ /mgrin par āḥdamar po/ /thugs kar hūṃ? sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ ces gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ de nas dbang bskur ba la/ tshe bum dang*/ tshe chang dang*/ tshe ril la rten nas dbang bskur ba dang*/ tshe spel ba dang bzhi'o/ /dang po la/ yar ba 'gug pa/ nyams pa gso ba/ tshe bstim pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ mdun gyi tshe dpag med kyi phyag mtshan bum pa'i nang gi hrīḥyig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi tshe mi ma yin gyis brkus pa dang 'phrog pa dang yar ba thams cad bum pa dang thod pa bdud rtsi'i gang ba'i rnam par bkug ste mdun gyi tshe dpag med kyi sku'i cha dang phyag gi bum nang gi sngags 'phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/

khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad 'grigs mer gyis gang bas tshe yar ba nyams pa sogs sor chud/ 'chi ba med pa'i tshe'i rig 'dzin 'thob byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /ces brda sprad nas/ rang gzhan gnyis kas de ltar bsams pa dang*/ gnyis kas a mā ra ṇi ci 'grub brjod cing dril bur krol/ spro na mthar rigs kyi bu 'di rnams kyi tshe mi shigs pa'i rdo rjer gyur cig /mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig /mi 'gyur ba'i g.yung drung du gyur cig /'chi ba med pa'i rig 'dzin thob par gyur cig /ces bden stobs brjod la me tog 'thor/ 'di 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyor/ rgyas par 'dod na shis brjod ri yang bya'o/ /gnyis pa nyams pa gso ba la/ tshe dang stobs bsod nams dang dam tshig dang sdom pa nyams pa gso ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ mdun gyi tshe dpag med kyi phyag mtshan bum pa'i nang gi hrīḥyig las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams gyi 'byung ba nam mkha'i khams kyi bkrag mdangs nus pa thams cad 'od dang bdud rtsi ljang khu'i rnam par bkug ste sngags 'phreng la thim/ zhes pa nas/ mer gyis gang bas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ khyad par du khyed rang rnams kyi 'byung ba nam mkha' sgo nas tshe nyams pa sor chud/ 'chi ba med pa'i tshe'i rig 'dzin thob byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /brjed pa sogs sngar bzhin bya'o/ /yang sngags 'phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kyi 'byung ba rlung gi bkrag mdangs nus pa thams cad 'od dang bdud rtsi sngon po'i rnam par bkug ste sngags 'phreng la thim/ nas khyad par du 'ang 'byung ba rlung gi sgo nas tshe nyams pa sor chud ces sogs sngar bzhin no/ /yang 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kyi 'byung ba me'i khams kyi bkrag mdangs nus pa thams cad 'od dang bdud rtsi dmar po'i rnam par bkug ste nas khyad par du 'byung ba me'i sgo nas tshe nyams pa sor chud ces sogs sngar bzhin/

yang 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kyi 'byung ba chu'i khams kyi ro bcud nus pa bkrag mdangs thams cad 'od dang bdud rtsi dkar po'i rnam par bkug ste nas khyad par du 'byung ba chu'i sgo nas tshe nyams pa sor chud ces sogs sngar bzhin/ yang mdun gyi tshe dpag med kyi phyag mtshan bum pa'i nang gi hrīḥyig las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kyi 'byung ba sa'i ro bcud nus pa bkrag mdangs thams cad 'od dang bdud rtsi ser po'i rnam par bkug ste nas khyad par du khyed rang rnams kyi 'byung ba sa'i sgo nas tshe nyams pa sor chud/ 'chi ba med pa'i tshe'i rig 'dzin thob byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /ces sogs sngar bzhin no/ /'di dag bsdu na/ 'od zer 'phros 'jig rten khams kyi 'byung ba sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i bkrag mdangs nus pa thams cad 'od dang bdud rtsi kha dog sna lnga'i rnam par bkug cing bsdus te bya ba sngar phyi rigs pas shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa stobs dang bsod nams nyams pa gso ba ni/ yang sngags 'phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus mthu bsod nams dang*/ lha klu mi la sogs pa'i bsod nams dang stobs dang gzi brjid thams cad dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang stobs dang gzi brjid dang sman dang sngags la sogs pa'i nus pa dang mdor na 'jig rten khams kyi dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad/ bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad la sogs pa'i rnam par bkug ste/ nas khyad par du yang khyed rang rnams kyi stobs dang bsod nams nyams pa sor chud/ ces sogs sngar bzhin/ gsum pa dam tshig dang sdom pa nyams pa gso ba ni/ yang sngags 'phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing gsum dang*/

sku gzugs dang gsung rab po ti dang rdor dril la sogs pa'i rnam par bkug ste nas khyad par du khyed rang rnams kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa nyams pa'i nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs/ dam tshig dang sdom pa nyams pa sor chud ces sogs sngar bzhin/ tshe 'gug pa sgos su byed na/ yang sngags 'phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ skye 'phags kun gyi tshe phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du rgyal ba tshe dpag med kyi sku tshe'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i rnam par bkug ste nas khyad par du khyed rang rnams kyi tshe nyams pa'i nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs/ tshe nyams pa sor chud ces sogs sngar bzhin bya'o/ /brgya tshar sogs byed na tshe yar ba 'gug pa nas 'di'i bar rgyas par ram bsdus te byas kyang chog go /gsum pa tshe bstim pa ni/ mdun bskyed kyi tshe dpag med khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor spyan drangs/ bum pa mgo bor 'jog pa'am bzhag par mos nas/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis= yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis= dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong srung ma thams cad kyis= khyad par du'ang rgyal ba tshe dpag med/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo la sogs pa'i tshe 'khrid brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig khyed rnams kyis slob ma 'di dag gi nad gdon bgegs bar du gcod pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzod/ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba las thar bar mdzod/ tshe ring bar mdzod/ srung bar mdzod/ skyob par mdzod cig /gzungs ring tshar gcig brjod la/ tshe dpag med 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rnam par zhu ste khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs snying kar thim pas byin gyis brlab par gyur par bsams/ tshar mang po byed na mdun bskyed las yang me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs bstim pa yin zhing*/

de yang tha mal bka' bsgo tshar gsum dang*/ gzhan rnams la lha re re bstim pa las bka' bsgom byas kyang chog go / gnyis pa tshe chang la brten nas dbang bskur ba ni/ sbyangs rtogs spar gsum pa byas nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe chang 'di gsol bas rtsa rlung thig le byin gyis brlabs pa bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skye ba'i nus pa khyad par can bzhag /rtsa rlung thig le'i nus pa nyams pa sor chud/ 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin thob byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /ces brjod la sbyin/ gsum pa tshe ril la brten nas dbang bskur ba ni/ tshe ril 'di rnams ni sman la sogs pa'i bcud thams cad bsdus nas byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ 'di zos pas nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi las grol ba'i nus pa bzhag /'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin thob byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /snying po bsdus pa'i bcud 'di ni/ /de ring khyod kyis bza' bar gyis/ /'di zos dus min 'chi ba las/ / grol 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces brjod cing sbyin no/ bzhi pa tshe spel ba'i shis brjod ni nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas kyis shis pa brjo par bsams te/ sbyin pa'i stobs kyi sangs rgyas yang dag 'phags/ /mi yi seng ge sbyin pa'i zhes sogs so sor bya ba'am/ phyin drug stobs kyis sangs rgyas zhes sogs rgyas bsdus ci rigs dang*/ 'dab bzang gtsug phud ces sogs dang*/ dus min 'chi ba'i zhes sogs dang*/ bgegs rigs stong phrag sogs dang*/ tshangs dang lha dbang sogs kyis shis brjod bya'o/ /spyir bsgrubs pa'i tshe ril la longs spyod pa dang tshe dbang 'di ltar byas pa la phan yon gyi yon tan gtso bo gnyis te/ gnas skabs tshe ring ba dang*/ phyi ma bde ba can du skye ba'i rten 'brel yod cing*/ sgos su gang la dmigs pa'i yul de nyid dus min 'chi ba las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe dpag med kyi sgo nas tshe ril sgrub pa dang tshe dbang bskur ba'i tshul 'chi bdag

/dpung 'joms 'chi med dpal ster zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang gi slob ma gnas brtan bya btang shes rab bkra shis kyis gzhan re gnyis la phan par bsams te bskul ba'i tshe/ shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis bla ma gong mas mdzad pa'i man ngag du ma la brten nas ji ltar 'tsham par co ne dgon nyid du sbyar zhing*/ dad pa dang rnam dpyod zung du 'brel ba'i gnas brtan bzod pa'i ming can gyis dad pas par du bsgrubs pa ste/ dge bas 'gro ba kun gnas skabs dus min 'chi ba las grol zhing*/ phyi mar bde can du skyes nas rgyal ba tshe dpag med yab sras kyis rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig/bkra shis/ dge'o// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/tshe ril bsgrub pa dang tshe dbang bskur tshul 'chi med dpal ster bzhugs/ -PAGE 232--PAGE 231--PAGE 230-
